headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty snap winning streak, falling over 300 points amid inflation concerns

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Benchmark indices snapped their winning streak in the last trading day due to profit booking.
Rising inflation concerns and crude oil pressures weighed on investor sentiment.
Specific stock pullbacks like Shriram Finance and Manappuram Finance pressured key indices.
Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles reported a Q2 net loss of ₹5,531 crore.
whatHappening: On the last trading day, Sensex fell 319 points while NIFTY50 ended at 25,144.
Shriram Finance was among the top losers during the last session.
Manappuram Finance shares dropped 4% during Friday's market decline.
Indian markets overall extended gains for the third straight week despite the final session dip.
summary:
On the last trading session, Sensex fell 319 points and NIFTY50 ended at 25,144, snapping a winning streak.
Market weakness was triggered by inflation concerns, crude oil pressure, and corporate losses like Tata Motors' Q2 net loss.
Despite the pullback on Friday, Indian benchmark indices managed to log a third consecutive week of overall gains.
